beats.say: You won't believe this. Tata Steel's India business made more profit than all of Tata Steel. So what's eating fourteen hundred crore?
The headline first. July to September, the whole group made three thousand six hundred and sixty-six crore. Up eighteen percent.
But the India business alone? Five thousand and fifty-five crore. Nearly fourteen hundred crore more.
lines: ₹1,389 cr MORE than the whole group

beats.say: So who's eating it? Mostly Britain. The UK plant lost seven hundred and nineteen crore, before interest and tax.
That's from Corus, the steelmaker Tata bought in two thousand seven for about twelve billion dollars.
lines: Corus: UK and Dutch steel plants

beats.say: India makes the money. Europe still eats a chunk. Send this to the friend who only reads the headline.
lines: Send this to someone who only reads headlines
